name: Owner complaint reply
lead: The complaint is cross-checked against the maintenance log, the bylaws, the building insurance policy and the service charge notice. You get an accurate, calm reply and the deadlines to meet; nothing is sent without you.

project.title: Leaks in unit 24 and a disputed service charge, Maple Court (fictional)

extracts.text: Third leak since June in my bedroom ceiling, under the flat roof. Nobody came. I refuse to pay the $1,240 of roof works billed this quarter until it is fixed.
Call-out on Sep 18, 2026: roof membrane flashing detached around the skylight, above unit 24. Temporary repair; full replacement needed.
Common areas include the structure, roofs and flat roofs, including their waterproofing.
Leaks through the roof covered; deductible $1,500. Claims must be filed within 5 working days of becoming aware of the damage.
Flat roof waterproofing: temporary repair on Sep 18, 2026. No insurance claim recorded.
Roof works charge (resolution 6 of the 2025 meeting): $1,240, due Oct 1, 2026.
Each owner pays the charges billed and may not withhold them because of a defect in the common areas.
Leaks reported in unit 24: Jun 14, 2026, Aug 2, 2026, Oct 5, 2026.
The manager replies in writing to owners' complaints within 8 days.

output.title: Reply to Ms Garland: draft
output.sub: Every statement links to its document. Tone, commitments and sending remain your decision.

items.t: Flat roof and waterproofing are common areas: the association is responsible for the repair.
Three reports (Jun 14, Aug 2 and Oct 5, 2026); a single, temporary call-out on Sep 18, 2026.
No claim filed with the building insurer: 5 working days to file, claim planned for {claim_date}.
The $1,240 charge is still due: the bylaws do not allow withholding charges because of a common-area defect.
Dear Ms Garland, we have received your message of Oct 5, 2026 and we understand your frustration after three leaks.
The roofer came on Sep 18, 2026 for a temporary repair above your unit; the full replacement of the waterproofing is under way.
We offer a visit with the roofer: {visit_slot}. The damage is being claimed with the building insurer on {claim_date}.
For damage inside your unit, please send us photos and repair estimates: we will add them to the claim.
The $1,240 charge remains due; a payment plan can be considered. [TO APPROVE by the manager].

contradictions.title: "Nobody came" although a call-out took place
contradictions.impact: The reply should mention the call-out without dismissing the problem: it was only temporary.
contradictions.action: Acknowledge the delay and explain what happens next.

contradictions.title: Damage never claimed with the insurer
contradictions.impact: A late claim can reduce or void the payout.

contradictions.title: Refusal to pay against the duty to pay charges
contradictions.impact: Unpaid charges would trigger reminders and fees for the owner.
contradictions.action: Explain the rule tactfully and offer a payment plan.
